mapper.sql: code_id AS codeId, code, local_partner_id AS localPartnerId, status, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, max_uses AS maxUses, use_count AS useCount, note, issued_by AS issuedBy, revoked_by AS revokedBy, revoked_time AS revokedTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_partner_onboarding_code WHERE local_partner_id=#{localPartnerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, code_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_partner_onboarding_code SET status='REVOKED', revoked_by=#{revokedBy}, revoked_time=#{now}, update_time=#{now} WHERE code_id=#{codeId} AND status='ACTIVE'
